page_title: MCI 2-0 WOL | Manchester City v Wolves 24/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' The corner kick is deflected to Matheus Mane (Wolves), who immediately sends in a long-range shot. However, he hits the ball poorly and it goes high over the bar.
90+6' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
90+5' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
90+4' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
90+4' The ball is cleared after Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Manchester City get a corner.
90+3' Rodrigo Gomes plays a lofted ball into Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) near the penalty spot, but the ball flies off the top of his head and goes high over the bar.
90+2' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+2' Matheus Mane (Wolves) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) is able to continue to play.
88' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
88' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
87' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
87' Matheus Mane (Wolves) will take the corner.
86' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) attempts to release Rodrigo Gomes with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players. Good work from Wolves as they win a corner.
85' The offside statistics – 0:6.
82' Andre (Wolves) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
82' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) heads on.
79' Andre (Wolves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
78' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the crossbar. Unlucky!
75' The corner from Phil Foden (Manchester City) is intercepted by Jose Sa.
74' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves), who has already been caught several times today.
74' Substitution. Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Omar Marmoush walks off.
73' Here is a change. Rayan Cherki is going off and Pep Guardiola gives the last tactical orders to Erling Haaland (Manchester City).
73' Matheus Mane (Wolves) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
72' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
72' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away. Wolves force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
71' The referee signals a substitution. Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) is brought on as a substitute for Hee-Chan Hwang.
71' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
70' Total attempts – 9:4. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:1.

69' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
68' Marc Guehi (Manchester City) sends a long ball forward to Antoine Semenyo, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
67' Joao Gomes (Wolves) has tested the patience of referee Farai Hallam and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
66' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
66' The resulting free kick from Matheus Mane (Wolves) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.

65' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Farai Hallam blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. There is a free kick near the sideline to Wolves.
63' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

62' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) sent a pass onto Rayan Cherki, who didn't get a chance to finish. The ball goes behind for a corner. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
61' Here's the change. Tijjani Reijnders leaves the pitch and Phil Foden (Manchester City) comes on as a substitute.
61' A wild effort from Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
60' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
59' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Antoine Semenyo.
59' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) swings in a cross from the corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma reads it well and gathers the ball.
58' Joao Gomes (Wolves) sprays a pass out to Jorgen Strand Larsen, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball. Wolves will take a corner kick.
57' Andre (Wolves) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
57' The resulting corner from Matheus Mane (Wolves) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
57' Matheus Mane (Wolves) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper. The ball goes out of play. Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
56' Matheus Mane (Wolves) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is out of play. Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner.
56' A pass into the penalty area from Matheus Mane (Wolves) is intercepted by the defence.
55' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Joao Gomes (Wolves), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance!
54' A clumsy foul by Abdukodir Khusanov (Manchester City) and Farai Hallam blows his whistle. Wolves earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
52' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) sprays a pass out to Tijjani Reijnders, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
50' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
48' The Manchester City players are exchanging some short passes.
46' Poor challenge! Andre (Wolves) is penalised for tripping and Farai Hallam blows his whistle. Manchester City are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) is replaced by Rodrigo Gomes.
46' Rob Edwards makes a half-time substitution. Jorgen Strand Larsen comes on in place of Jhon Arias (Wolves).
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

45+2' 2 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Bernardo Silva, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City), who beats Jose Sa with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) sends a sweet pass into the box towards Rayan Cherki. He looks to dribble past an opposing player, but fails and the ball is cleared.
44' Rodri (Manchester City) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
43' Farai Hallam blows his whistle after Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
42' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
42' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) tries to threaten the goalkeeper as he takes the ball and fires from long range. The shot flies just over the crossbar!
39' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Manchester City as the referee indicates there was no infringement!

36' Play continues despite the shouts by some Manchester City players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Farai Hallam interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
35' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the right post! What an opportunity that was!
35' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
33' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) commits a foul and Farai Hallam immediately signals a free kick.
32' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked.
31' 4:1 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 3:0.
28' A spell of possession for Manchester City in an attempt to control the game.
26' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
26' Farai Hallam blows his whistle for a foul after Joao Gomes (Wolves) hacks down one of his opponents. Free kick. Manchester City will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
24' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) sends a long ball forward to Antoine Semenyo, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
24' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
21' Matheus Mane (Wolves) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
19' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Omar Marmoush.
19' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
17' Chance! Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Omar Marmoush, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the left post.
16' 69:31 – the latest ball possession ratio.
14' Andre (Wolves) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Farai Hallam blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Manchester City.
12' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) sends a precise pass into the box, but Rayan Cherki loses the one-on-one with the defender.
11' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Manchester City.
10' Great save! Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Jose Sa.
9' A crossfield pass from Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) fails to find any of his teammates.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Matheus Nunes puts a cross into the box and finds Omar Marmoush (Manchester City), who latches on to it and strikes the ball low into the middle of the net. He makes it 1:0.

5' Joao Gomes (Wolves) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Hee-Chan Hwang was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
4' Marc Guehi (Manchester City) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
4' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
4' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester City.
3' Farai Hallam blows his whistle as Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
2' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) tries to play a long through ball into Omar Marmoush, but the defence breaks the move down.
1' Matheus Mane (Wolves) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Wolves will take the kick-off.
Farai Hallam was nominated as the referee for this game.
